card.name: Endings of fractions and Tenon's capsule
card.fires_on: The final piece of a split word, mainly the -ths or -th ending of written fractions (three fifths) and the -on in Tenon's capsule. It also fires on a few other word endings, such as the 4 in '40s and the -riday in Friday.

modes.label: Fraction endings
modes.description: The -ths or -th ending of a spelled-out fraction such as three fifths or one twenty-fourth.
